integrity: Explicit local equivalence, finite excluded-order enumeration, six-state concatenation argument, and standalone standard-library checker; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only proper fall three-colour existence for GP(n,3) at n>=7 and the published-upper-bound corollary for even orders; neither other palettes nor all colouring counts are treated; unindexed equivalent prior work and an inaccessible 2012 conditional-chromatic full text remain historical-priority risks.
title: A sharp fall-three-colouring threshold for third-step generalized Petersen graphs
